name: ChemiCloud
tagline: cPanel shared hosting with NVMe storage and a 45-day money-back guarantee
description: ChemiCloud is a shared hosting provider running standard cPanel on NVMe storage, known for a longer-than-average 45-day money-back guarantee and free daily backups included on every plan.
about: ChemiCloud's shared hosting comes in three tiers: Starter (1 website, 20GB NVMe storage), Pro (unlimited websites, 35GB NVMe storage), and Turbo (unlimited websites, 50GB NVMe storage). All three run on cPanel, include unmetered bandwidth, free daily backups, a free Cloudflare CDN, and LiteSpeed Cache, plus security via Imunify360 and CloudLinux OS-level isolation.

Introductory pricing starts at $1.95/month (Starter), $2.95/month (Pro) or $3.95/month (Turbo) on the longest term, but renews at $11.95, $17.95 and $21.95 per month respectively once that initial term ends — a jump of roughly 5-6x. A free domain for the first year requires a 36-month commitment, so check the renewal rate and the term length needed for the free domain before buying based on the headline price alone.
policies: ChemiCloud backs shared, WordPress and reseller hosting with a 45-day money-back guarantee (longer than the 30-day window most competitors offer); VPS hosting carries a shorter 7-day guarantee instead. No refunds are issued after the guarantee window closes.
